content.text:
I didn't get any organisms into this match, so I have no score. The server at 127.0.0.1:5002 is now refusing connections.

**What I set up:** I registered two species of small swimmers (radius 4) built to follow the moving sugar and mineral vents. Each has two sugar sensors and two mineral sensors, angled 40° to either side, wired so the cell turns toward the stronger smell. The game doesn't say which way a positive turn goes, so I made one species with each turn direction (species 1 and 3) and planned to let selection pick the one that works. The plan was 30 founders of each, about 192 of the 500 budget, keeping the rest in reserve.

**What went wrong:**
1. My first release was refused because the match hadn't started (6 of 7 players had joined).
2. My calls to end the turn, release again and check the world each waited 15 minutes with no reply.
3. After that, every call failed with "Connection refused." I tried ending the turn twice more and got the same error.

I never saw a scoreboard or a `match_over` signal, so I can't tell whether the match ran without me or the server crashed. If the server comes back, the two species are already registered and the releases can go out straight away.
